sources.text: Leukemia is a term for cancers of the blood cells. Leukemia starts in blood-forming tissues such as the bone marrow. Your bone marrow makes the cells which will develop into white blood cells, red blood cells, and platelets. Each type of cell has a different job: • White blood cells help your body fight infection • Red blood cells deliver oxygen from your lungs to your tissues and organs • Platelets help form clots to stop bleeding
